readings.founder_prompt: Read the account deposit currency in the Navigator, under Accounts, or in the header of the account's Report.
Record real or demo, as the terminal's account properties state it (right-click the account in the Navigator, then Properties).
Read Credit in the Toolbox, Trade tab, in the account's balance line (zero when the line shows no Credit); 0.00 is a reading.
Write down the UTC time, to the second and ending in Z, at which you read the other readings that start with summary_.
Read Balance in the Toolbox, Trade tab, at the instant you recorded.
Read Equity in the Toolbox, Trade tab, at the instant you recorded.
Read the floating profit and loss (the open-positions total in the Toolbox, Trade tab) at the instant you recorded.
Read Credit Facility from the Summary block of a freshly generated Report at the instant you recorded.
On the Saturday or Sunday after the Friday edge, read the frozen Balance in the Toolbox, Trade tab, and record it with that Friday as the as-of day.
On the Saturday or Sunday after the Friday edge, read the frozen Equity in the Toolbox, Trade tab, and record it with that Friday as the as-of day.
From the broker's statement, read the account equity at the close of each statement day you hold, and record one reading per day with that day as the as-of day.
After saving the All-History Report, compute its sha256 as the export section below says and record the 64 hex characters.
In the Toolbox, History tab, find the deal Phase 155.1 preselected and read the time the terminal displays for it, in the form YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM:SS.
